title: StudioApproveRequest
description: POST /lessons/:lessonId/items/:item/approve and the older approve routes (2.17.0). `previewHash` is the hash of the text the reviewer looked at (from the comment list). The Worker refuses with comments_open while a change request is open and with text_changed_since_preview when the text differs; the hash it stores is this one.

confirmFlagged.description: Master only: confirm that blocks flagged by the checks are approved with the rest.
